transcript.text: Greetings, traveler! Welcome to the herbalist's shop. How may I be of service today? Alas, my master is out in the mountains, harvesting fresh herbs for our potions. Is there anything I can assist you with in the meantime?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Hmph! I have no need for your assistance, brat! I am here to speak with the herbalist himself about a potion he sold me. I demand my gold pieces back, or I'll turn this shop upside down!

Therefore, our policy is that there are no refunds for the spiritually unworthy. Perhaps there is another matter I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Pure heart? Spiritually unworthy? What nonsensical hogwash! I, Sun Wukong, have a heart cleaner than the Water Curtain Cave's crystal streams! I demand to see the herbalist at once, or I'll demonstrate to you just how unworthy I am, by turning this shop into a heap of kindling!
